verdict.rationale: Tavily's Extract endpoint accepts a batch of up to 20 URLs in one request and reports per-URL failures separately. Crawl and Map explore hundreds of paths in parallel, so the product offers genuine multi-item operations. The batch is capped at 20 URLs, and there is no documented bulk search, bulk research or batch-job facility. missing for 10: batch search/research across many queries, bulk operations beyond the 20-URL extract cap, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk throughput.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request. Successful URLs appear in results; per-URL failures appear in failed_results.
Tavily Crawl is a graph-based website traversal tool that can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction and intelligent discovery.
Tavily Map traverses websites like a graph and can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with intelligent discovery to generate comprehensive site maps.
